name: zip
description: Creates .zip archives — the format Windows and macOS open natively.

flags.description: Read filenames to add from stdin.

examples.explanation: Zips the whole project directory recursively.
Creates a password-protected archive (prompts twice for the password).
Zips a site while excluding node_modules.
Lists zip contents without extracting (companion command).

about: zip stores files individually (unlike tar's single stream), which allows random access but preserves fewer Unix metadata details (no reliable owner/permission preservation — fine for documents, imperfect for system backups). Encryption: standard zipcrypto is weak; prefer 7z or gpg for sensitive data.
useCases: Upload bundles to services that expect .zip.
mistakes: Forgetting -r for directories — you get an empty zip.
Assuming zip -e is strong encryption — it is legacy-grade; use gpg for real security.
warnings: zip encryption is historically weak (ZipCrypto). For confidentiality, use 7z with AES-256 or encrypt with gpg.
